scope: CPU-only deterministic structural counts; no timing, CUDA, or end-to-end claim
trend: Reuse P=4 partitions; filter with first two pivot dimensions only; no extra partition search
pivot_selection: Exact first four entries of the verified prior S0/S1 sequences, independently for each snapshot; no reselection

partition_definitions.P0: Fixed prior L3 DFS permutation, chunk 256; not per-snapshot query-selected best
partition_definitions.P2: Recursive widest local norm span, tie lowest pivot dimension; sort by (norm, occurrence ID); split at floor(n/2); left then right; stop n<=256
partition_definitions.P3: P2 but local norm span / snapshot-global norm span; zero global span contributes zero

partition_boundary: Keep recursive leaf boundaries, never flatten/rechunk. P0/P1 have 3907 blocks (last 64); P2/P3 have 4096 blocks of 244/245. Report counts, sizes, physical occupancy and surviving active objects.
numerics: Reuse baseline NUMERICS.md and interval/rejected/radius_upper without changes. Norm signatures are rounded FP64 sqrt; certificate uses conservative outward endpoints, not rounded norms.
oracle: Original 32 exhaustive ordered-FP64 references; membership score<=FP32_radius_squared; query, radius, oracle never enter partition or pivot construction
aggregate: Arithmetic mean of all original 32 queries per snapshot, no query selection

gates.GO: At least one identical S/P partition, P=4, zero false prune, mean surviving block fraction <=0.50 on BOTH snapshots
gates.STRONG_GO: GO with both means <=0.35; final label GO
gates.CONDITIONAL_SUPPORTED: No GO; a joint configuration has both means <=0.65, at least one >0.50, and both mean oracle fractions <=0.10
gates.NO_GO_GLOBAL_PIVOT: No GO; among certificate-aware P1/P2/P3 and S0/S1, per-snapshot minimum mean surviving fraction is >0.70 in at least one snapshot and >0.50 in the other. Optimistic per-snapshot envelope protects against rejecting a better tested method.
gates.UNCOVERED: Otherwise CONDITIONAL with reason=uncovered_interval, not evidence that the stated 50%-65% gate passed. No CUDA, no expanded search or automatic new-summary experiment.
gates.correctness: Any false prune or input/provenance failure stops immediately, no performance judgment

top_one: Among S0/S1 x P1/P2/P3 at P4, minimize (max(snapshot means), arithmetic mean of snapshot means, strategy string, partition string); frozen before observing results

updates.selection: One identical top-one configuration, two independently initialized intervals, not sustained ownership across rebuilds
updates.authorized_initialization: User confirmed capacity-aware balanced initialization on 2026-10-11, before measurements. For P2/P3 root leaf budget=ceil(N/240). At each node with m>1 target leaves: choose same split dimension; left leaf budget=floor(m/2); cut=floor(n*left_budget/m); right gets remainder. Stop m=1. Preserve resulting variable leaf boundaries; never flatten/rechunk. P0/P1 retain their ordering and chunk 240.
updates.actual_occupancy: Report actual block sizes and 1-N/(256*num_blocks), not nominal slack as exact measured slack. Re-evaluate this distinct initialization before and after updates.
updates.placement_and_split: Reuse baseline Ownership.apply/refresh/query: scan all block centroids for best match, lowest-ID tie, lowest hole insertion, local split at 257; no change to rules. Global scan cost is not local computation.
updates.validation: After each event affected ownership/slots/bounds; full final occurrence+lineage state against next snapshot; original 32 queries before and after; false prune=0
updates.gate: changed_blocks/initial_blocks <=0.05, moved_existing/N<=0.05, global repartition during events=0; initialization is global and reported separately

novelty: Established pivot-space partition/median split/interval filtering; this is a bounded falsification diagnostic, not a new-method novelty claim. Before any later CUDA prototype require a separate nearest-prior-art kill test.
